segments.text: Today we're looking at a project that completely flips the way you think about the terminal. It's called term.
And yes, it literally lets you run any guey application right inside your terminal. Want to fire up Firefox from
your SSH session? Done. Want to play a video game in the terminal inside a web browser over SSH? This project can pull
that off. Term everything isn't just a hack. It's actually a customuilt way compositor that renders straight into your terminal instead of your monitor.
That means whether you're on kitty iTerm 2 or elacrity, you can tune the resolution and frame rate to balance clarity and performance. It's not just
about showing off. This tool makes remote development, debugging, and even lightweight guey usage inside terminal
workflows way more flexible. So, if you're tired of terminal only file viewers and just want to use the real apps you already have, term.
